builder.objective: REPAIR V3-01: Invert the money precondition: the counterparty must have a positive receivable at least equal to the settlement amount (e.g. sufficient = counterpartyMoneyBalance >= moneyAmountMinor - 1e-9, exposing availableReceivable = counterpartyMoneyBalance), and fix the error message accordingly. The accepted baseline scenario (counterparty +1500, settlement 500) must pass; a settlement exceeding the counterparty's receivable must fail.; Thread previously applied settlements into the balance computation inside the sequence loop (e.g. pass appliedSettlements to calculateContributionBalances/calculateFinancialBalances, or add a priorSettlements parameter to validateSettlementPreconditions) so each subsequent settlement is checked against balances that include all earlier settlements.; Use the full structural validation (validateCrossLedgerSettlement from crossLedgerSettlement.ts, which imports only from validation.ts — no circular dependency) in both replay paths, replacing the weaker inline validateSettlement/validateSettlementMoney checks.; Rewrite the tests with the correct semantics: the valid-settlement scenario must use the accepted baseline setup (counterparty owed money, e.g. b paid 3000 for [a,b]); add a genuine accumulation test (s1 consumes all available credit, s2 overshoots -> invalid); add replay-rejection tests for rate-inconsistent settlements in both ledger calculations.
builder.scope: Repair only the audited must-fix findings on the preserved V3 baseline; do not rebuild accepted work.
